reason: Half my orders come by call, and recording every call sounds like extra work I won't keep up with. My paper udhaar diary and UPI QR already work, so I don't see enough reason to change right now.
objection: Half my orders come by call, so this misses them. I won't record every call at the counter, and I don't want to hand my udhaar diary to a system I can't trust.
would_change_my_mind: If the person who sets it up stays in my shop for a week, moves my udhaar diary in for me, and I see it catch my phone-call orders without any extra effort from me.
